newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Incyte rating downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Incyte rating downgraded.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said Friday it downgraded its recommendation on Incyte Pharmaceuticals Inc to buy from neutral based the company's stock price reaching 70-3/4 during yesterday's session.
-- Vector said the downgrade was also a response to the stock's "phenomenal run." Incyte's shares climbed more than five points yesterday before closing down 1-1/2, Vector said.
-- Incyte's initial market capitalization doubled in 1996 and is now up 20 percent for the year to date, Vector said.
-- Vector said it has every confidence in the company's fundamental operations, adding that Incyte's shares should trade at 50 times Vector's fiscal 1998 earnings estimate of $1.52.
-- Incyte is a biopharmaceutical development company.
-- Its shares were trading off 3/4 Friday at 67.
